description: This file defines an interface class 'IEventHandler' within the 'WPEFramework::Plugin' namespace. The class declares pure virtual functions corresponding to different event callbacks that accept JSON data structures or event identifiers.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface class specifying callback methods for handling various events, such as runtime manager events, window manager events, ripple events, and state change events.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime manager events, accepting a JSON object with event data.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events, accepting a JSON object with event data.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple events, accepting an event name and JSON data.

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles state change events, accepting a JSON object with event data.
